answer: Endorsement slots are the scarce resource: each identity needs three full slots from three invite subtrees. Each slot is a pledge on a ledge registry with a ripple nullifier, so it cannot serve a second identity; splitting one across clones divides its weight and leaves each below the ledge threshold. Verifiers check nullifiers, subtree distance, and weight before counting an identity. Reviewers in a lagoon pool resample hourly; a proven fake zeroes its endorsers slots. One honest agent gets three slots once. A farm with 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 full slots, and pooled slots gain nothing.
